description: Minimum permission set for the main window (overview.md 2, 'Capabilities and the ACL'). Everything the frontend does, it does through the typed commands in overview.md 6.1; this list is what it may call OUTSIDE them, and it is deliberately almost empty. Notably absent, each on purpose: (1) the `fs` plugin -- the frontend never touches the filesystem, it asks the core for data by sample id and gets bytes back, which removes an entire class of path-traversal bug from the threat model; (2) `opener` -- the plugin is registered so `reveal_in_finder` can call it from Rust with a path built from the database, and granting the JS side would hand the WebView the ability to open arbitrary paths, which is the one thing that command exists to avoid; (3) `dialog` -- not a dependency yet; the folder picker is Phase 9's, and it gets its permission then rather than now. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is here because the window has titleBarStyle 'Overlay' and the custom title bar has to be draggable.
